attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared, world-writable directory (mode 1777, owned root:root) with the sticky bit set so users can create/write files but cannot delete or rename files owned by other users. Verified functionally with two test OS users (alice, bob): each could write their own file, neither could delete the other's file (Operation not permitted), and each could delete their own file. Cleaned up test files and users. Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id, issued `sudo reboot`, polled until node1 came back, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified /srv/drop permissions and writability post-restart.
